parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL2146312. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id and assay organism. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort the results by compound_chembl_id.
